messages:
Jared: thanks for tuning in today  posting the finance follow-up thread \u2014 drop questions here.
Maya: quick recap: runway ~18 months on plan; downside scenarios and controls are in the slide deck.
Sam: can we get the month-to-month burn split again? payroll vs infra vs go-to-market.
Maya: monthly ~ $3.2M: payroll ~ $1.4M, infra/GPU ~ $1.25M, GTM ~ $350k, misc ~ $200k. Rounded.
Ivy: procurement thresholds? last renewal surprised my team.
ProcurementBot: new thresholds effective today: txn <= $1k = p-card ok; $1k-$5k = manager approval; $5k-$25k = Director + Finance; > $25k = Legal + CFO. Renewals > $15k auto-hold. Submit via https://redwood.internal/procure.
Devon: SLA for approvals? some infra buys took ages last quarter.
FinanceOps: SLA targets: <=$1k: same day; $1k-$5k: 2 business days; $5k-$25k: 5 business days; >$25k: 10 business days. Expedited customer-impact path available.
Sam: expedited path details?
Maya: tag tickets with "expedite_customer", include product lead + finance sponsor, and add a rollback plan. We'll triage within 24 hours for legit customer-impact.
Ivy: manager delegated budgets for tooling to avoid blocking sprints?
Leah: Managers can approve up to $1k. Directors can approve $1k-$5k with Finance CC. Anything above goes through standard review.
Devon: capex for GPUs  could we buy racks to lower opex?
Maya: we're running two capex pilots for Dedicated capacity. Any capex > $200k requires ROI analysis + board notification. Small on-prem pilots will be evaluated case-by-case.
Sam: if bookings drop 15% what triggers a board update or company-wide freeze?
Jared: Board notification at <12 months runway. Before that, we use selective hiring pauses and reprioritization. No company-wide compensation actions planned today.
Ivy: what about vendor auto-renewal handling? which teams get flagged?
ProcurementBot: contract owners will get flagged for renewals > $10k; auto-hold for > $15k. Flags visible in the procurement portal.
Devon: any central discretionary pool for small emergency infra purchases?
FinanceOps: Yes  we've established a $200k/month pre-approved pool for verified customer-impacting spend. Teams must register spend in the ticketing system and reconcile weekly.
Sam: forecasting  do teams need to refresh Q2 numbers?
Maya: Yes  all teams should submit a reforecast for Q2 by COB next Friday. Template in #finance-docs.
Ivy: exceptions process  urgent >$25k?
Maya: Open a procurement ticket, tag @Jared + @Leah, include customer-impact justification and rollback plan. We'll aim for a 24-48 hour decision window for real emergencies.
Devon: will any of this be communicated externally to customers? some have asked about stability.
Jared: Not right now  internal guidance only. If we need to, Sales + Comms will coordinate an external message.
Sam: who to ping for 1:1 budget questions?
Leah: Finance office hours Wed 10-11 PT and Fri 3-4 PT; also use #finance-ops for async questions.
Maya: we'll post the updated approval matrix, procurement playbook, and a short FAQ to #finance-docs within 24 hours.
Ivy: thanks 44d will update my onboarding notes.
Jared: closing this thread  reach out if you need help or an exception.
